item.title: ‘MAGA in Lights’: White House drops Christmas video — Watch
item.description: The White House released a Christmas Eve video. It featured a scene from a popular movie. The house lights spelled out MAGA. The video gained attention online. Supporters reacted positively to the message. The clip conveyed a festive and patriotic sentiment.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: "Do you think I’ll ever be real?" AI VTuber Neuro-Sama questions her existence in viral Twitch moment
item.description: A popular AI VTuber, Neuro-Sama, has captivated audiences by questioning her own reality and purpose during a recent Twitch stream. Her recent profound queries about being 'properly real' and her desire to matter beyond entertainment have sparked widespread online discussion about AI consciousness and its place in the world now.

item.title: ‘Boys from the Bronx’: Emails show UCLA professor Mark Tramo standing by Jeffery Epstein
item.description: Newly surfaced emails reveal UCLA neuroscience professor Mark Tramo pledged loyalty to Jeffrey Epstein, even after learning of his impending guilty plea for soliciting a minor. Tramo referred to their bond as "boys from The Bronx," emphasizing enduring friendship.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: MrBeast reacts to Valkyrae controversy as viral clip ignites debate over women and having children
item.description: Popular streamer Valkyrae's declaration about not having children sparked online debate, with some deeming her choice 'sad' and others defending her autonomy. Fellow streamer MrBeast intervened, criticizing the public's intense scrutiny of her personal life. His reaction shifted the focus to why such private decisions become widespread public arguments, highlighting the internet's tendency to amplify personal choices into controversies.

item.title: “They are making antisemites”: Megyn Kelly blames Ben Shapiro and Bari Weiss while defending Tucker Carlson publicly
item.description: Megyn Kelly accused Ben Shapiro and Bari Weiss of fueling antisemitism inside conservative circles while saying Tucker Carlson is not responsible. Her comments came after public clashes over Israel, cancel culture, and Candace Owens. Ben Shapiro responded at AmericaFest, calling neutrality immoral. The feud has deepened divisions in conservative media.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Epstein files fallout: Did White House steps in to control DOJ messaging — Here's what we know about report
item.description: The White House is now managing the Justice Department's social media after the chaotic release of Epstein files. Despite promises of transparency, the DOJ faced criticism for deletions, premature releases, and questionable documents, including a fake letter. Officials are frustrated by the ongoing fallout and the persistent conspiracy theories surrounding the ongoing review of millions of records.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Amid H-1B row and vetting delays, Indian applicant reveals sudden visa reversal from ‘refused’ to ‘approved’
item.description: The US State Department has expanded social media screening for skilled-worker visas, impacting H-1B and H-4 applicants. One applicant shared their experience of delays and passport retention, followed by an approval within a week. This individual advised others to remain patient and provide full social media links on their DS-160.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘This woman ran for President’: Kamala Harris’s dating advice sparks debate online
item.description: Kamala Harris, on a political sabbatical, offered dating advice on a podcast, suggesting women choose partners who allow laughter and can be enjoyed in various "phases," from "Friday night" to "Sunday morning" relationships. While some found her tips relatable for modern dating, many netizens expressed disappointment, expecting more profound wisdom from a former Vice President, leading to mixed reactions online.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'You’re an anchor baby': Indian-American influencer Priya Patel faces backlash over 'America for Americans' demand
item.description: New H-1B visa policies are causing job insecurity for employees and employers. These changes have sparked division between American citizens and H-1B workers. An Indian-American influencer, Priya Patel, faced strong criticism for her "America for Americans" post. Her past statements on culture and immigration also drew controversy. The situation highlights growing tensions surrounding immigration and national identity. Read more here!
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What is 'winter vomiting bug'? Why a new variant is driving a US surge?
item.description: A potent new norovirus variant is fueling a nationwide surge, coinciding with rising cases of flu, whooping cough, measles, and COVID-19. This highly contagious "winter vomiting disease" is causing significant outbreaks, particularly in California, with health officials urging vigilance and strict hygiene practices to curb its spread. While symptoms are usually short-lived, vulnerable groups may require medical attention.

item.title: Who is Anna Gorisch? 'Indian Jewish Feminist Nazi Immigration' attorney sparks online storm with AI-generated image amid MAGA backlash
item.description: Immigration attorney Anna Gorisch sparked online debate with an AI-generated image depicting her as an "Indian Jewish Feminist Nazi Immigration Attorney." The image, shared after a comment on birthright claims, led to backlash from MAGA supporters. Gorisch, who specializes in employment-based immigration, later embraced the controversy, stating, "I contain multitudes."
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Eating rice with hands, speaking Hindi — is that America?’ Nick Fuentes launches anti-India Christmas rant
item.description: Far-right activist Nick Fuentes has sparked outrage with racist and anti-India slurs on his podcast, claiming immigrants are erasing American Christmas traditions. He specifically targeted Indians, Somalis, and Asians in Texas, Minneapolis, and Seattle. His comments, which also included offensive remarks about other minority groups, have drawn sharp criticism on social media.

item.title: “That was her”: N3on’s Viral IRL Moment Sparks Speculation After Alleged Kris Tyson Sighting
item.description: A short clip from N3on’s IRL livestream with Ryan Garcia went viral after the streamer claimed he spotted Ava Kris Tyson at a movie theater. His shocked reaction sparked heavy online speculation, though the sighting remains unconfirmed. Tyson, largely offline for over a year, has not commented on the viral moment.

item.title: 'Radical activists and weaponized NGOs': US denies visas to EU ex-commissioner, four others over tech rules — who are they
item.description: America has denied visas to five European individuals. The US State Department stated these figures sought to force American social media platforms to censor certain views. European leaders, including French President Emmanuel Macron, have condemned the move. They assert these actions undermine European digital sovereignty and regulatory autonomy. The European Union plans to respond decisively if needed.
